svg.title: Top scores per question: vector search alone vs reranked
svg.desc: Each dot is one question's best score, searching one upload. With cosine scores, answerable and unanswerable questions overlap between about 0.5 and 0.9. Reranked, answerable questions score 0.64 to 0.94, while wrong uploads and off-topic questions fall to 0.24 to 0.51, below the 0.58 threshold; 2 near-misses stay above it.
svg.text: Each dot is one test question's best score, searching one upload. Left of the line, the app replies "not found" without calling the LLM.
